integrity: The theorem is proved from the published edge criterion; finite enumeration is reported only as an independent stress test of the closed formula.
scientific_limitations: Consecutive cardinality intervals only; arbitrary gapped S are not covered.
The finite checker reaches dimension 8 and is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
An older equivalent formulation under cardinality-homogeneous terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact graph metric of consecutive-layer S-hypersimplices
